# Start Forcing Player To Be Hero

Source: [wiki article 4448](../archive/4448.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Start Forcing Player To Be Hero](../../api/actions/start-forcing-player-to-be-hero.md).

<a id="wiki-4448-n1"></a>

- Forcing hero may immediately respawn the player at their current location and makes that the only selectable hero until Stop Forcing Player To Be Hero.
